facts.fact: A commentary says about 30 million SIMs were linked to Ghana Cards and 21 million completed biometric capture in the 2021-23 exercise, with biometrics never authenticated against NIA records.

A commentary reports the Communications Minister's planned new SIM registration using API integrations between mobile operators, the NCA and the NIA for real-time biometric cross-checks, with an L.I. before Parliament and procurement of a service provider underway.
